narr: Monsoon moisture over northern Arizona produce scattered showers and thunderstorms. One thunderstorm produce heavy rain and flash flooding over northern Gila County.
ev: Pine Creek was flowing around 3 feet deep through Pine. Pinewood Tavern at Highway 87 and Hardscrabble Mesa Road was closed due to flooding.
lsr: Estimated Pine Creek running 3 feet deep. Pinewood Tavern at Hwy 87 and Hardscrabble Mesa Rd closed due to flooding.
